copy.tagline: Free task management for people and AI agents
copy.registryDescription: Task management for people and AI agents, with scoped OAuth access to issues, projects, and docs.
copy.directoryShort: Free, realtime task management with issues, boards, sprints, docs, analytics, and OAuth-scoped MCP access for AI agents.
copy.directoryMedium: Orbit is a free, realtime, keyboard-first task manager for software teams and AI agents. It combines issues, boards, sprints, projects, docs, analytics, GitHub integration, and an OAuth-scoped MCP server. The code is Apache-2.0, with no billing code or paid tiers.
copy.productHunt: Orbit is a free, realtime, keyboard-first task manager with issues, boards, sprints, projects, docs, analytics, GitHub integration, and an OAuth-scoped MCP server that lets AI agents work with exactly the permissions of the person who authorizes them.
copy.selfHosted: Orbit is Apache-2.0 and can be evaluated locally. Provider-neutral production self-hosting is currently Preview; the hosted application is the supported realtime deployment today.
copy.mcpDirectory: Orbit lets AI agents read and manage issues, sprints, projects, docs, and files through a remote OAuth-secured MCP server. Grants are workspace-bound, revocable, and scoped; an agent never receives more permission than the person who authorizes it.
